verdict.rationale: Archived docs and a probe describe Smithery's connection layer for agents (a REST interface that brokers MCP server connections and handles OAuth and credentials), and a probe reports an official MCP server documented at /docs/use/connect. Smithery's own later shutdown notice concretely contradicts this: Connect, the API, API keys, the CLI and the SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a non-proxied registry. Missing for 10: a currently working connection service, a clearly first-party MCP endpoint that agents connect to directly, and independent hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://smithery.ai/docs/use/connect
Smithery gives you a simple REST interface for connecting to MCP servers.
